forecast_target.primary: Probability of one or more earthquakes in a specified geographic region, magnitude range, and future time interval
forecast_target.underlying_quantity: spatiotemporal magnitude-conditioned event intensity lambda(x,t,M | D)
forecast_target.note: A high slip deficit or positive Coulomb stress change is a physical covariate, not itself a calibrated earthquake probability.

legacy_models.name: Smoothed historical per-cell Poisson baseline
known_limitations: Current cell counts are not a full time-dependent clustered model
Current implementation does not resolve magnitude bins
Must test catalog completeness and event dependence

legacy_models.name: K0 plus NNR-MORVEL56 and PB2002 kinematic features
known_limitations: Relative velocity features exist in only part of the current 500-km grid
MORVEL is long-term rigid-plate motion, not present-day regional GNSS deformation
PB2002 line geometry is not a mapped seismogenic fault inventory
Current median imputer fills missing feature values

legacy_models.name: K1 plus Coupling Cloud and Slab2 features
known_limitations: Physical data union is sparse
Current Poisson feature pipeline median-imputes missing physical values
Coupling and slab variables refer to different geological objects and cannot be conflated
Multiple Coupling Cloud datasets may be dependent

legacy_models.name: K2/K1 plus static coseismic Coulomb stress transfer
known_limitations: Receiver faults are not a complete mapped inventory
PB2002-derived receiver scenarios are assumptions
Stress calculation radius is 2500 km
The current product does not use spatially variable subfault slip by default
Outside calculated stress coverage NaNs are converted to zero stress before applying the background rate

legacy_models.name: K3 plus Dieterich rate-and-state response to a static stress step
known_limitations: Depends on K3 receiver/source assumptions
Uses a single coseismic stress step
Uses broad parameter scenarios not calibrated by region
Does not ingest measured afterslip, viscoelastic relaxation, fluid-pressure evolution or a complete stress history

candidate_models.name: GEAR1 reproduction and modernized GEAR1-inspired global baseline
candidate_models.reference: Bird et al. (2015), DOI 10.1785/0120150058; reproduction materials in Dryad DOI 10.5061/dryad.cnp5hqcjb
candidate_models.domain: Static long-term global shallow seismicity rate, depth <=70 km; published threshold Mw>=5.767; not time-dependent
candidate_models.evaluation_gate: First reproduce original published grid and scores/parameters. Then build a separately named modern variant, evaluate on rolling-origin periods and compare to K0, GEAR1 frozen baseline, and ETAS.

method.seismicity_parent: Kagan-Jackson anisotropic smoothing of shallow Global CMT events Mw>=5.767, 1977-2004; minimum background component is 1 percent of global shallow seismicity
method.tectonic_parent: SHIFT-GSRM2f; geodetic strain-rate tensors converted to long-term seismic moment rate using elastic parameters, tectonic zone classes, coupled seismogenic thickness, and tectonic-class frequency-magnitude distributions
method.hybrid: H_ij = normalize(max(S_ij^d * T_ij^(1-d), f)); preferred published d=0.6 on Seismicity and 0.4 on Tectonics
method.validation: Original paper calibrated/tested hybrid against 2005-2012 Global CMT events; additional comparison against independent ISC-GEM events 1918-1976
method.time_behavior: No explicit time dependence; total seismicity without declustering

candidate_models.name: Global or regionally parameterized ETAS
candidate_models.reference: Ogata ETAS family; evaluate regional parameterization and global transfer
candidate_models.domain: Regions with sufficiently complete event catalogs; global version requires explicit regionalization/completeness handling
candidate_models.evaluation_gate: N-test, space-time likelihood tests, calibration, and comparison with simple rate baselines

candidate_models.name: GSRM/GNSS strain-rate model
candidate_models.domain: GSRM v2.1 plus future compatible GNSS updates; preserve rigid/deforming domain masks
candidate_models.evaluation_gate: Ablation against seismicity-only model; out-of-sample likelihood and calibration

candidate_models.name: Regional fault/block model and interseismic slip deficit
candidate_models.reference: Use region-specific published inversions; examples Li et al. (2025) for Tibet and Zhao et al. (2025) for Java-Timor
candidate_models.domain: Only within each inversion's published and resolution-tested domain
candidate_models.evaluation_gate: Replicate source paper, preserve posterior uncertainty, test transfer to unseen time periods

candidate_models.name: Coseismic elastic stress transfer on explicit receiver faults
candidate_models.reference: Okada elastic dislocation family; CUTDE implementation may be retained after verification
candidate_models.domain: Only locations with defensible source rupture and receiver-fault geometry
candidate_models.evaluation_gate: Benchmark against published stress calculations, geometry sensitivity, and controlled historical forecast tests

candidate_models.name: Dieterich rate-and-state response
candidate_models.domain: Only where stress history and regional parameters are sufficiently constrained
candidate_models.evaluation_gate: Regional calibration, sensitivity tests, and incremental skill over ETAS

candidate_models.name: Regional and global calibrated forecast ensemble
candidate_models.reference: CSEP-style prospective/rolling-origin evaluation and ensemble-weight optimization
candidate_models.domain: Global baseline plus region-specific eligible modules
candidate_models.evaluation_gate: Must outperform or be statistically competitive with strongest simple baseline on held-out periods; probabilities must be calibrated

combination_rules.missing_required_physical_input: Model ineligible for affected cell/segment; retain global baseline and report no physical refinement
combination_rules.correlated_sources: Group by shared observations, catalog, inversion, or model lineage; downweight or jointly model their dependence
combination_rules.calibration: Calibrate final probabilities on held-out rolling-origin forecasts only; never calibrate on the evaluation target window
